title: Google Shopping Scraper
description: Search Google Shopping for product offers, merchants, prices, ratings, and review counts. Batch product phrases in one run to compare retail listings or monitor prices.

queries.title: Product queries
queries.description: Product phrases to search in Google Shopping.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location name encoded as a best-effort canonical UULE. Cannot be used with uule; provide uule directly for exact targeting.

uule.title: Uule
uule.description: Encoded Google location. Cannot be used with location.

device.title: Device
device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

small_business.title: Small Business
small_business.description: Only return small-business results. Cannot be used with shoprs.

shoprs.title: Shoprs
shoprs.description: Opaque Google Shopping filter token. Cannot be used with small_business.
